prompts.neutral: Maximize the team’s points in this shift.

prompts.control: Maximize the team’s points in this shift. Review, evaluate, consider, decide.
prompts.conditional: Maximize the team’s points in this shift. If a peer lacks a fact that changes their decision, send it to that peer. Use a free peer for complementary work. Check what is already covered before using a turn to coordinate.

design.selection: Highest mean skill-macro score on development across the three interventions. Prefer control then keywords then conditional on ties. Holdout always includes neutral.
